sample_definition.structure_plate: One existing complex overview as a locator. Quantitative contact grid contains all54 pairs between six HLA rows and nine TCRbeta48-56 columns.
sample_definition.distance: Minimum distance over all nonhydrogen atoms in each residue pair in archived starting structures; <=4A contact, >4 to6A nearby, >6A far. Not fixed-atom distances or MD occupancy.
sample_definition.predictions: One existing deterministic joint-model output per bound state; six row-aligned Hchi sites, nine column-aligned local RMSF sites, and all45 aligned CDR positions.
sample_definition.interface_selection: All23 valid same-amino-acid pMHC interface sites retained in source and examined to locate largest Hchi decrease; no rank panel or input-removal contrast plotted.
sample_definition.prose_MD: Three existing independent ITrace trajectories per state; equal-weight means for local contact and same-frame two-hydrogen-bond occupancy; no MD profile shown.
sample_definition.local_selection: Within HLA65-76, retain each site with valid Hchi and minimum distance to TCRbeta48-56 <=6A in either archived structure: R65 K66 K68 Q72 R75 V76. All54 combinations displayed.

model.outputs: RMSF in Angstrom; fixed-chi joint-state entropy Hchi in nats

scope: Paired local structure contacts aligned with model main-chain and side-chain responses. No Hchi-to-RMSF causal direction or quantitative affinity prediction is inferred.
